notes: Brand Kit Pro: LOGO-ON-MOCKUP — the brand logo is now stamped ONTO every mockup photo (18 zones, all 5 templates + 10-artboard book), not blank photos. Logo source: selected artwork straight from Illustrator (default, transparent PNG24 export >=1000px), or your own PNG file, or the generated text logo. Guideline consistency enforced: uniform scale only (never stretched), clearspace 15% of stamp width, min-size floor 64px/20mm (too-small zones skipped, named in the status line), same variant rule on all zones (reversed-white on dark/busy photos, primary on light), photo tint sits UNDER the logo. Anti-generic: kit is brand-driven (own colors/fonts/story/values/personality, invented slogans removed), template suggestion from industry/personality, mood word from personality in photo searches. No true perspective warp (flat/front-on photos only). NOTE: mockups download at runtime only; live manifest keeps the full 22-file list (PNGs excluded: updater is text-only).
